scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail false --names 'next,peers,term,lan' --prefix-colors 'blue,cyan,magenta,green' --restart-tries 0 'tsx scripts/run-next-with-env.ts dev' 'tsx scripts/start-peer-services.ts' 'tsx scripts/terminal-pty-server.ts' 'tsx scripts/lan-port-proxy.ts'
scripts.predev: tsx scripts/run-action.ts sync_plugins && tsx scripts/health-check.ts && tsx scripts/ensure-peers-current.ts
scripts.build: env -u NODE_ENV -u TURBOPACK -u PORT -u __NEXT_PRIVATE_STANDALONE_CONFIG NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096 --no-deprecation --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning' next build --webpack
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail false --names 'next,peers,term,lan' --prefix-colors 'blue,cyan,magenta,green' --restart-tries 0 'tsx scripts/run-next-with-env.ts start' 'tsx scripts/start-peer-services.ts' 'tsx scripts/terminal-pty-server.ts' 'tsx scripts/lan-port-proxy.ts'
scripts.prestart: tsx scripts/run-action.ts sync_plugins && tsx scripts/health-check.ts && tsx scripts/ensure-peers-current.ts
scripts.test: env -u DEVHUB_DESKTOP -u DEVHUB_APP_DATA -u DEVHUB_RESOURCE_ROOT -u DEVHUB_SERVER_DIR -u NOTES_DIR -u TASKS_DIR -u COLLECTIONS_DIR -u UPSTARTS_DIR -u DOCS_DIR -u DEVHUB_OP_CACHE_DIR -u DEVHUB_OP_CACHE -u DEVHUB_OP_REFRESH -u DEVHUB_OP_SYNC_LOCAL -u DEVHUB_OP_ITEM -u DEVHUB_OP_VAULT -u JIRA_API_TOKEN -u GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET NODE_ENV=test NODE_OPTIONS='--no-deprecation --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning' vitest run
scripts.test:watch: env -u DEVHUB_DESKTOP -u DEVHUB_APP_DATA -u DEVHUB_RESOURCE_ROOT -u DEVHUB_SERVER_DIR -u NOTES_DIR -u TASKS_DIR -u COLLECTIONS_DIR -u UPSTARTS_DIR -u DOCS_DIR -u DEVHUB_OP_CACHE_DIR -u DEVHUB_OP_CACHE -u DEVHUB_OP_REFRESH -u DEVHUB_OP_SYNC_LOCAL -u DEVHUB_OP_ITEM -u DEVHUB_OP_VAULT -u JIRA_API_TOKEN -u GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET NODE_ENV=test vitest
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && rm -rf .next-verify && DEVHUB_SKIP_NEXT_TYPECHECK=true DEVHUB_VERIFY_BUILD=1 npm run build && DEVHUB_VERIFY_BUILD=1 npm run check:dynamic-routes
